payload.title: Switch 2 demand flagging in US as Nintendo cuts production targets by a third
payload.content: After initial record-breaking launch sales, demand for Nintendo Switch 2 appears to be weakening, especially in the US market. Nintendo has reportedly reduced production targets from 6 million to 4 million units. Multiple sources indicate US consumer price sensitivity and tariff concerns are the primary factors.

signals.signal_label: Switch 2 需求减弱，生产目标下调
signals.description: Nintendo Switch 2 需求减弱，尤其是在美国市场，导致生产目标从 600 万台下调至 400 万台。
